Title: 1 in 5 Podiatry Visits Are for Ingrown Toenails - Trim and Shoe Habits to Fix

Description:
Ingrown toenails send about 1 in 5 podiatry patients through the door, and they show up most in kids, young adults, and people in their 50s. Tight shoes plus rounded or too-short trimming are the two leading causes. Choose a wide toe box, trim straight across, and don't wait out spreading redness or pus — soak in warm water 15-20 minutes and see a doctor if it doesn't improve.
